# app-tokens delete

Command: `boundary app-tokens delete`

The `app-tokens delete` command deletes an app token given its ID.

## Example

The following example deletes an app token with the ID, `appt_1234567890`.

```shell-session
$ boundary app-tokens delete -id appt_1234567890
```

## Usage

<CodeBlockConfig hideClipboard>

```shell-session
$ boundary app-tokens delete [options] [args]
```

</CodeBlockConfig>

### Command options

- `-id` `(string: "")` - The ID of the app token to delete.
